adopted: Topic and lesson signposting; coherent grammar/vocabulary identities; concise accurate reference; focused retrieval; usable back links.
changed_for_horizons: Concept-specific pictures/native diagrams before grammar practice rather than dense tables alone.
Vocabulary consolidates introduced words through unique practice games, decisions, clue sets and fresh source resources, not duplicated lesson picture sheets.
Enough space and consistent ordinary typography; extra pages forUnits1and8 rather than compression.
Six original practice-specific teaching images support new games; no core vocabulary picture is reused in the banks.
Sixteen genuine reserved QR areas prepare future Blooket self-study/class play without fake codes or unconfigured links.
not_copied: No reference exercise wording, artwork, branding, page composition or worksheet scans are incorporated into the product.
author_correction: The author clarified on1November2026 that vocabulary practice should not re-present the same lesson input or recycle the same resources. Brief grammar repetition remains acceptable.
